in_marathi.name: Madhwan
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Lord of Knowledge, Scholar
in_marathi.long_meaning: Madhwan हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Madhwan is a Sanskrit name derived from the word 'madh' meaning 'knowledge'. It is also associated with Lord Anantheshwara, who is known as the embodiment of knowledge and wisdom. The name is a tribute to those who seek knowledge and wisdom in their lives.
